training.training_peak_change_counts: not recorded by this frozen training logger; not inferable as zero
training.random_RMS_statistic: maximum row RMS in each logged 1024-fake batch; not mean RMS or population uncertainty
training.regular_decomposition: regular contains realized RMS+second-difference terms and mean ADC saturation; separate components not logged

fixed_evaluation.interpretation: One fixed TRAIN bank and projection, 512 SOURCE parents x4 draws. Descriptive proxy improvement, not a scientific gate, uncertainty, convergence, or noGAN-vs-GAN causal result.

parameter_tanh_interpretation: Small parameter values or their norms do not determine tanh saturation: controls=tanh(control_average(head(frozen decoded))). No decoded features or tanh activations were evaluated in this readback.
loss_gradient_scope: Only total new-head preclip gradient norm is logged, no per-loss parameter-gradient attribution or cosines. Gradient mechanism requires a separately registered bounded analysis.

recommendation.next_action: First use saved paired parent-cluster arrays to quantify whether the small final-vs-A gain is stable and separate pure-signal from ADC/peak/crop effects. If stable but mechanism unresolved, register fixed-bank per-loss new-head gradient attribution before a matched GAN control.
recommendation.GAN_causal_control: Any future GAN comparison must use the same new head, initialization, data/noise banks, optimizer and G budget with adversarial on/off. Old full19k differs in architecture/randomness/stage/history and is not a causal control.
recommendation.training_batch_metrics_vs_fixed_evaluati: Never splice these into one numerical learning curve; logged metrics use refreshed projections and current unpaired 1024-row batches and pre-step parameters. Fixed evaluation uses a different constant 2048-row parent bank and fixed projection.
